intelligence.human_view: A certificate is not a form with a name on it. It is the moment a person becomes a member of something — and the moment has to feel like it. "This certifies that Shawn" overlapping the name is not a layout bug; it is the document failing to be a document. The fix is not a nudge of a few pixels; it is a re-conception: the name is a royal object — obsidian in the middle, purple glow around the edges, like one of our buttons, a real object — and the words around it say exactly what the act is: you signed the Collective Agreement, you agree to follow its rules, you are now a member of the Society of NayaNET, a new digital civilization, a world. "We call it a world" is the sentence that makes the membership mean something: not a plan, not an account, a world you now belong to. And the proof standard changed with it: his viewport (1851×1009) is now a mandatory verification width, because the probes at 1440×900 never saw what he saw. His eye on his screen is the only measurement that counts — again.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you join a magical club, and you get a beautiful certificate with YOUR name on it — big and royal, like a shiny black jewel with a purple glow all around it! And the certificate says: "You signed the promise, and now you're a member of our Society — a whole new world!" Writing your name IS signing the promise — and that makes it official! You're in!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — when you join something special, you sign your name, and that signature makes it official. The certificate is beautiful — your name sits there like a royal jewel, dark and shining with a purple glow around the edges, the nicest presentation of a name you've ever seen. And it says plainly: you signed our agreement, you'll follow the rules, and now you're a member of our Society — a whole new world, dear. Your name makes it real.
intelligence.naya_view: By entering your name, you make it official — you are signing the Collective Agreement, and you agree to follow its rules. Your name is a royal object: obsidian in the middle, purple glow around the edges.
